title: Signed webhook verification
why: Incoming payment or integration webhooks are verified (HMAC over the raw body, timestamp tolerance, secret rotation) before the handler runs.
changelog: Signed webhook routes verify HMAC-SHA256 signatures

adopt.snippet:
<meta server>
export default {
  method: 'POST', path: '/payments/events', auth: 'public', body: 'raw',
  verify: { scheme: 'timestamped', header: 'x-payment-signature', secret: 'PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET' }
}
